title: Reorganize documentation following industry best practices
body:
## Documentation Optimization - COMPLETE ✅

This PR reorganizes and optimizes the ObjectUI documentation following industry best practices (Microsoft Docs, Google Developer Docs, Stripe Docs).

### Completed ✅
- [x] Analyze current documentation structure
- [x] Identify documentation framework (Fumadocs + Next.js)
- [x] Identify duplication and organizational issues
- [x] Research industry best practices
- [x] Reorganize documentation structure
- [x] Create FAQ document
- [x] Create comprehensive Troubleshooting Guide
- [x] Create Security Best Practices guide (with proper CSP)
- [x] Move architecture specs to proper location
- [x] Create Migration guides section
- [x] Simplify guide section (removed 4 redundant files)
- [x] Update all meta.json navigation files
- [x] Improve main index page
- [x] Create Ecosystem index page
- [x] Consolidate community section
- [x] Create Examples documentation page
- [x] Enhance examples/README.md
- [x] Update README.md with new documentation links
- [x] Fix CSP security configuration (removed unsafe-inline)
- [x] Fix Fumadocs build by adding missing meta.json files
- [x] Add required frontmatter to all markdown files

### New Documentation Structure
```
docs/
├── guide/              # Getting Started (simplified)
│   └── cli/           # ✅ Added meta.json
├── components/         # Component Library
├── concepts/           # Core Concepts
├── plugins/            # Plugin System
├── reference/          # API & Protocol Reference
├── architecture/       # Architecture Specs (moved from community)
├── ecosystem/          # Integrations & Deployment
│   └── deployment/    # ✅ Added meta.json
├── migration/          # Migration Guides (NEW, ✅ frontmatter fixed)
├── troubleshooting/    # Problem Solving (NEW)
├── community/          # Contributing & Roadmap (simplified, ✅ frontmatter fixed)
├── examples.md        # Examples Documentation (NEW)
├── faq.md             # Frequently Asked Questions (NEW)
├── security.md        # Security Best Practices (NEW, ✅ CSP fixed)
├── versioning.md      # Versioning & Releases (NEW)
└── index.md           # Improved landing page
```

### Security Improvements
- **CSP Configuration**: Replaced `'unsafe-inline'` with nonce-based and hash-based approaches
- **XSS Protection**: Enhanced security guidance to prevent script injection attacks

### Build Fixes
- Added `meta.json` for `docs/guide/cli/` subdirectory
- Added `meta.json` for `docs/ecosystem/deployment/` subdirectory
- Added YAML frontmatter to `docs/community/contributing.md`
- Added YAML frontmatter to `docs/migration/from-objectstack.md`
- Ensures Fumadocs can properly parse and build all documentation sections
